# Muneeb Khan MK Real Estate

MK Real Estate is a trusted local property dealership operating in Havelian, Sultanpur, Abbottabad, Haripur, Mansehra and the wider Hazara region of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan.

Business name: Muneeb Khan MK Real Estate
Short name: MK Real Estate
Website: https://mkrealestate.vercel.app
Phone: +92 315 5881733 (Muhammad Ayan Khan)
Phone 2: +92 313 5820606 (Haider Ali Shah)
Email: info@mkrealestate.example
Region served: Havelian, Sultanpur, Abbottabad, Hazara, Haripur, Mansehra

## Services
- Buy property: residential plots, houses, commercial property, agricultural land
- Sell property: listing, verification, connecting with serious buyers
- Property investment: plots and land with growth potential across Hazara
- Rentals: houses, portions and shops
- Documentation: guidance on fard, registry and ownership paperwork

## Commission
- 2.5% from the selling party
- 1.5% from the buying party
- Commission terms agreed before any transaction
